title: Scan QR code
intro: Point the camera at a QR code; the matching action runs automatically.
introPermits: Point the camera at a classroom entry, late arrival, exit permit, or gate QR code. The matching action runs automatically.
introLibrary: Point the camera at a library visit QR code. The visit is recorded automatically.

results.classroom_entry: Your attendance is recorded in {teacher}'s class.
results.exit_stage: The {stage} stage of your exit permit is confirmed.
results.exit_stage_plain: Your exit permit stage is confirmed.
results.exit_approved: Every stage of your exit permit is approved. Show the gate QR to security.
results.late_arrival_open: Late arrival opened and waiting for the next step.
results.library_visit_already: Your visit was already recorded less than 30 minutes ago, so it was not recorded twice.

failures.expired: The code has expired or was already used. Ask for a new QR code.
failures.libraryVisitExpired: This library QR code was already used or has expired. Scan the new code on the library screen.
failures.lateArrivalBusy: Your late arrival is already being processed and is not waiting for a scan.
failures.noPermitAwaitingDesk: None of your exit permits is waiting for the duty teacher's approval. This code only approves the duty teacher stage of an exit permit in progress.
failures.permitAtOtherStage: Your exit permit is waiting for {stage}, and this code cannot approve that stage. Scan the QR code from {stage}.
failures.permitAwaitingReview: Your exit permit is waiting for {stage} to review it. This code is not needed.
failures.permitAwaitingGate: Every stage of your exit permit is already approved, so this code is not needed. Show the gate QR to security.
failures.permitLessonsOver: The lessons on your exit permit are over, so it cannot go any further and this code is not needed. The permit expires on its own.

unknown.bare: Code not recognised. Scan the QR directly, or paste the full code starting with "sion:".
unknown.unsupported: This kind of QR code is not supported.
unknown.missing_instance: The QR code is incomplete. Ask for a new QR code.
unknown.unavailable: This QR code belongs to a feature that is not enabled at your school.
